question: Where did the art of puppetry first come into being?
solution:
The correct answer is "**India**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The **theme **of the given comprehension is about **puppetry **and how it evolved as an art form, It can be a medium of communication as well as a source of entertainment for young and old alike.
 
• In the **first **paragraph of the given comprehension, it is mentioned that puppets came into being in India in the **third century A.D**.Here it was honed into a theatrical art. It helped to propagate the works of saints and religious leaders, and also depict stories from epics.

**Hence, the correct answer is option 1**
